name: Barbados Snorkeling Tours by Hayden Browne
summary: Hayden Browne hosts small group snorkel trips from Holetown Beach on his own boat, Bajan Breeze, which he launched in March 2026 after eight years working on another local boat. Each trip stops with turtles, tarpon and stingrays, then over a reef and a sunken barge, and he photographs guests in the water. Payment is in cash.
standouts: Does not promote touching wildlife or coral reefs
Owner Hayden Browne is your only contact and host

contact.address: Holetown Beach, on the beach of the Surfside and Zaccios restaurants, St. James, Barbados

trips.title: Snorkeling Tour
trips.summary: A snorkel trip of about one and a half to two hours with two stops near Holetown. The first stop has tarpon, sea turtles and stingrays, and the second is over reef and a sunken barge in 25 feet of water with many reef fish. Five departures a day, with photos of you in the water included.
highlights: Two stops in the Holetown area
Sea turtles, tarpon and stingrays, then reef and shipwreck
trips.departsFrom: Holetown Beach, by the Surfside and Zaccios restaurants
trips.checkNotes: Cash only. Adults and children pay the same rate. Booking is a request form on the home page and the tour times page that shows availability and sends an email confirmation; no card payment. The contact page (last changed 2019) still shows older rates (Regular Adult US$50.00/BB$100.00, Kids under 14 US$25.00/BB$50.00, 2 hours, times 9:20 AM / 12:20 PM / 2:15 PM); used the current home page rates. Tour times page gives each departure as a two hour window (for example 7:20 AM to 9:20 AM). Site says its stingrays are 'friendly and trained by us'.

trips.title: Nearby Hotel Beach Pickup + Snorkeling Tour
trips.summary: The same Holetown snorkel trip with a boat pickup from the beach of a listed west coast hotel. Pickup and boarding times are confirmed by WhatsApp at least 24 hours before the trip.
highlights: Pickup time confirmed by WhatsApp 24 hours ahead
Guests at other hotels meet the boat at Holetown Beach
trips.departsFrom: Beach pickup at Fairmont Royal Pavilion, Glitter Bay Resort, Colony Club Hotel, Coral Reef Club Hotel, Sandpiper Hotel, Royalton Vessence, Mango Bay Hotel, The Club Barbados Hotel, Sandy Lane Hotel, Tamarind Hotel, The House Hotel, Beach View Hotel, Crystal Cove Hotel or Waves Resort & Spa
trips.checkNotes: Cash only. Duration not stated separately for the pickup option. The booking form does not show a separate pickup option; check how pickup is requested.

trips.title: Private Tours
trips.summary: A private snorkel trip for your own group, with more time at each stop and more chances for photos and video. Suggested for nervous or non-swimmers, families with young children and special occasions.
highlights: Suited to non-swimmers or nervous swimmers
trips.checkNotes: No price shown; the contact page says 'Private tours: Contact us for rates'. Enquiry by phone or WhatsApp.
